values.note: recreation.gov sells sites at $22 a night in the peak season and $24 in the fall first-come season; the Forest Service page says $24 per site. A one-time $11 fee to enter the Eleven Mile Canyon Recreation Area (annual pass $100); $11 for a third vehicle.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/spillway-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Parking spurs 20-45 ft; trailers 25 ft maximum. recreation.gov's catalog lists 22 sites, 13 of them tent-only; the 8 RV/trailer sites are back-ins of 25-35 ft. One RV per site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/spillway-campground ('It has 23 campsites with parking spurs 20-45 feet and a maximum trailer length of 25 feet'; 'The max length for RVs/trailers is 20-45 feet') + recreation.gov per-site catalog, read 2026-10-27

values.note: Well water from a hand pump. Firewood sold at the host site.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/spillway-campground ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site. Well water is available.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233721 ('vault toilets, picnic tables, hand pump for drinking water'; 'Firewood is available for sale at host site'), read 2026-10-27

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/spillway-campground ('This campground is open mid-May to mid-October, weather dependent.'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov or at 877-444-6777, up to 180 days ahead; booking closes 5 days before arrival (the Forest Service says four), and sites left unreserved become first-come. The 2027 reservation season runs May 28 to September 5, then first-come until October 10 (in 2026 reservations ran May 15 to October 11). Weekend minimum 2 nights, holiday weekends 3; recreation.gov marks the weekend minimum soft, so it may be relaxed for a same-day booking, and walk-ups are exempt.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/spillway-campground ('Call 877-444-6777 or visit recreation.gov at least four days or a maximum of 180 days in advance. A minimum stay on Friday and Saturday night is required on weekends. A three-night minimum stay is required on holiday weekends. Walk-ups are exempt from the nightly minimum.'; 'No more than a 14-night consecutive stay') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233721 (rules minWeekendStay 2 'soft', reservationCutOff 5, maxConsecutiveStay 14) + /rates (season dates), read 2026-10-27

note: Last campground up Eleven Mile Canyon, on the South Platte River below the Eleven Mile Reservoir dam; trailhead for the Overlook Trail. Concessionaire-run (recreation.gov contact (661) 702-1420). Bear closure order: store attractants hard-sided. --Claude
